notes.title: The all-new version 3.1 is now live
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

[*] Added in-game new achievement levels (4 levels)
[*] Added 4 team achievements
[*] Added sound effects for all skills
[*] Optimized menu interface icons
[*] Improved in-game lighting effects
[*] Added a skill tutorial text when skills are acquired
[*] Increased the number of likes displayed in the level list
[*] Improved game performance and efficiency
[*] The first 20 challenge levels now grant a star
[*] Added tutorial information for placing objects

[h3]Due to the fix of a bug that previously allowed higher scores, all leaderboard scores have been reduced by a factor of ten[/h3]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed level loading lag issues
[*] Corrected display errors in some languages
[*] Removed email usage information from the EULA as we do not utilize email
[*] Fixed tutorial clue text overflowing the screen
[*] Fixed the issue of the boss moving when hit at high altitudes
[*] Fixed stacking issues with objects in first-person view
[*] Corrected basketball throwing trajectory issues
[*] Fixed occasional invisible walls appearing in first-person camera view
[/olist]

This update aims to enhance the functionality and user experience of the game while fixing several critical bugs to ensure players enjoy a smoother and richer gaming experience.

We are continuing to fix more bugs, and we would greatly appreciate it if you could join our Discord channel to report any issues!
https://discord.gg/tVJJ2CEkn6

notes.title: V0.3 Update Plan
notes.notes:
[h3]In the next update, we hope to bring more interesting gameplay, richer characters, and more diverse scenes:

Therefore, we will introduce a new mode, new stories, new cards, and a new art style[/h3]

New modes:
[list]
[*] Story mode - As God, weave the world and give an ordinary cardboard box a heroic journey!
[*] In story mode, players will use limited cards to complete a level goal
[*] These goals include [reaching the finish line], [scoring a certain score], [shooting a golden ball]
[*] These goals will also be added to existing modes, and players will be able to customize level goals when building their own levels
[/list]
New cards:
[list]
[*] New skills - time manipulation, etc.
[*] New objects - UFOs, bulletin boards, arrow towers, etc.
[*] New pick-up items - blood bags, strength pills, etc.
[*] More cards including mini-map, 2.5D camera, etc.
[*] What other cards do you want to add? Join our Discord group (https://discord.gg/SySUSHXM4w) and tell us!
[/list]

The new version is expected to be updated at the end of the year, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Summer 2023 Update Plan
notes.notes:
Creative Console has been online for 5 months, and we have received many valuable suggestions. Thanks to all the players who participated in the EA test.

Currently, the game has the following problems:
[list]
[*] The process of creating levels is not interesting enough, and it is time-consuming to test the levels you have created.
[*] The diversity of creative cards needs to be increased to create more diverse and distinctive levels.
[*] The server is not stable enough and often freezes or even drops the connection.
[/list]

To solve these problems, we plan to spend the next three months exploring more possibilities in gameplay and renewing the game by changing its core mechanics. [b]Our goal is not to be a clone of "Mario Maker" or "Roblox", but to truly bring players a new experience.[/b] So don’t be surprised if it will change to something completely new, AI? multiplayer? You will see it.

Of course, the game will continue to be open for free, and the server will keep running.

One more thing, welcome to join the Discord group and give us your idea, suggestions, and feedback.
https://discord.gg/SySUSHXM4w

notes.title: 0.2.2 Update - New Rank Unlock
notes.notes:
New rank added:
Rank 3

Achievements added:
Unlock all store items
Unlock ranks 1-5 (5 Achievements)

Feature changes:
Color tags added to boxes and keys
Settings can now be adjusted while paused in-Game
When a level receives a 5 Star rating, Add one more likes automatically

Card changes:
Maximum jump limit decreased: 10 times the default value -> 2.5 times the default value
Jump gravity reduction card changed: unlimited use -> one-time use only; Hight change -50% -> -25%

Bug fixes:
Fixed issue where other players' levels were not displayed
Fixed issue where likes were not recorded
Fixed issue where endpoint could not be selected after being deleted
